full_text: We had this one guy who had applied for a company, sort of help from the company and he said that his wife needed to get an operation done of her leg. And while we were sort of trying to help him out and we were trying to figure out a way of how we would muster enough funds to be able to help him. In the meantime, one of the guys at Islamabad Serena Hotel, he got hit by a car and he died and he had six children who were dependent on him. So we had to weigh whether we wanted to have this guy whose wife wanted to get an operation done or were we going to have a family of six people. you know so yeah we have a good service allowance and not only that you know we provide a lot of projection to the guys who are working well you know we make sure that they're getting to all the you know in our line of work the temporary duties that we do with the foreigners that fetches a lot of money so all the guys who are working with us who have a you know who work harder than the others you know we make sure that they go on those temporary duties with the foreigners and all. And, of course, that translates into better monetary benefits as well.
